constraints.name: scp_interview_findings_ai_run_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (ai_run_id) REFERENCES scp_interview_ai_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: scp_interview_findings_case_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (case_id) REFERENCES scp_interview_cases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: scp_interview_findings_created_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: scp_interview_findings_human_actor_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (human_actor_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: scp_interview_findings_manual_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (((origin IS DISTINCT FROM 'human'::text) OR ((ai_run_id IS NULL) AND (operation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (creation_request_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(length(btrim(neutral_question)), 0) > 0) AND (COALESCE(length(btrim(next_action)), 0) > 0) AND ((source_passage_id IS NOT NULL) OR (COALESCE(length(btrim(source_label)), 0) > 0)) AND (claim_class = ANY (ARRAY['source_grounded'::text, 'human_clarification'::text])))))

constraints.name: scp_interview_findings_question_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (question_id) REFERENCES scp_interview_core_questions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: scp_interview_findings_source_passage_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_passage_id) REFERENCES scp_interview_source_passages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: scp_interview_findings_verification_rule_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (verification_rule_id) REFERENCES scp_interview_verification_rules(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
